name: AXFRA ALARSI Checkerboard Press Wall
swap_rule: The ID is referenced. The press wall scale, lighting, and proportions may be adjusted while preserving the checkerboard pattern and the exact alternation of AXFRA and ALARSI.

backdrop.coverage: fills the entire background behind the subjects
backdrop.grid_structure: precise checkerboard with evenly sized squares, consistent spacing, and perfectly aligned rows and columns
backdrop.content_rule: each square contains one centered, clearly legible brand name, alternating between AXFRA and ALARSI in a consistent repeating pattern
backdrop.spelling_rule: both names must be spelled exactly as AXFRA and ALARSI
backdrop.style: authentic VIP concert photocall sponsor wall
backdrop.forbid: no other brands, no logos, no misspelled text, no additional signage
